item.title: Ancient height trends show technological advances did not always improve living standards
item.description: New research from the University of Tübingen and the Max Planck Institute of Geoanthropology in Jena gives valuable clues as to economic development in various regions across thousands of years. The study has been published in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. Fuente: Phys.org.
